title: 2021 年 6 月英语六级真题（第 1 套）

analysis.topic: 海南岛概况与发展前景
analysis.reference: Hainan is China's second largest island, second only to Taiwan, and is the southernmost province of China. Boasting beautiful scenery, a pleasant climate, abundant sunshine, rich biodiversity, numerous hot springs, and crystal-clear seawater, Hainan Island has most of its beaches serving as ideal places for swimming and sunbathing almost all year round. It is therefore hailed as China's "four-season garden" and a premier holiday resort, attracting large numbers of tourists from both home and abroad every year. Since it was established as a province in 1988, Hainan has witnessed rapid development in tourism, the service industry, and the high-tech industry, and it is China's only provincial-level special economic zone. With the strong support of the central government and people across the country, Hainan will be built into China's largest pilot free trade zone.

sentences.cn: 海南是仅次于台湾的中国第二大岛，是位于中国最南端的省份。
sentences.en: Hainan is China's second largest island, second only to Taiwan, and is the southernmost province of China.
sentences.structure: 并列谓语结构，两个 is 并列，second only to 作插入语补充排名关系，southernmost 用最高级表方位
keys: 中国第二大岛 China's second largest island
中国最南端 the southernmost ... of China

sentences.cn: 海南岛风景秀丽，气候宜人，阳光充足，生物多样，温泉密布，海水清澈，大部分海滩几乎全年都是游泳和日光浴的理想场所，因而被誉为中国的四季花园和度假胜地，每年都吸引了大批中外游客。
sentences.en: Boasting beautiful scenery, a pleasant climate, abundant sunshine, rich biodiversity, numerous hot springs, and crystal-clear seawater, Hainan Island has most of its beaches serving as ideal places for swimming and sunbathing almost all year round. It is therefore hailed as China's "four-season garden" and a premier holiday resort, attracting large numbers of tourists from both home and abroad every year.
sentences.structure: 现在分词短语 Boasting... 作原因状语统领六个并列名词短语；主句用 has...serving 结构；第二句被动语态 is hailed as，尾部 attracting 为伴随结果状语
keys: 气候宜人 a pleasant climate
温泉密布 numerous hot springs
中外游客 tourists from home and abroad

sentences.cn: 海南1988年建省以来，旅游业、服务业、高新技术产业飞速发展，是中国唯一的省级经济特区。
sentences.en: Since it was established as a province in 1988, Hainan has witnessed rapid development in tourism, the service industry, and the high-tech industry, and it is China's only provincial-level special economic zone.
sentences.structure: Since 引导时间状语从句用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时 has witnessed 表持续至今的变化，and 并列分句补充身份信息
keys: 建省 be established as a province
高新技术产业 high-tech industry
省级经济特区 provincial-level special economic zone

sentences.cn: 在中央政府和全国人民的大力支持下，海南将建成中国最大的自由贸易试验区。
sentences.en: With the strong support of the central government and people across the country, Hainan will be built into China's largest pilot free trade zone.
sentences.structure: With 介词短语作条件背景状语前置，主句用一般将来时被动语态 will be built into 表规划目标
keys: 中央政府 the central government
全国人民 people across the country
自由贸易试验区 pilot free trade zone

keys.en: high-tech industry / high and new technology industry

pitfalls: 「仅次于」误译为 inferior to 或 only after，应用 second only to
「建省」直译为 build a province，应为 be established as a province
「自由贸易试验区」遗漏「试验」一词，pilot 不可省略，否则与「自由贸易区」混淆
「省级经济特区」中 provincial-level 易遗漏 level 或整体缺译
长句中六个并列描写若逐一写成独立短句，会造成逗号拼接错误，应用分词短语或 with 结构整合

upgrades.note: boast 常用于介绍地方特色，比 has 更地道正式，体现夸赞语气
hailed as 语气更庄重，贴合「被誉为」的赞誉色彩
witness 作主语转换使句式更丰富，属于高分书面语表达

upgrades.plain: attract many Chinese and foreign tourists
upgrades.better: attract a multitude of tourists from home and abroad
upgrades.note: from home and abroad 为固定搭配，比 Chinese and foreign 更地道自然
crystal-clear 形象生动地强调海水清澈透明，比 clear 更具表现力
